segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Set up the session. let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance() do { try session.setCategory(.playback, mode: .default, policy: .longFormAudio, options: []) } catch { fatalError("Unable to configure the audio session: \(error)") } // Set up the player. let player: AVAudioPlayer do { player = try AVAudioPlayer(data: audioData) } catch { print("Unable to set up the audio player: \(error)") // Handle the error here. return } // Activate and request the route. do { try await session.activate() } catch { print("Unable to activate the audio session: \(error)") return } // Play the audio file. player.play() ```
